errors.evidence: The phrasing is redundant and potentially confusing. The axis label is "Хиляди лева" (Thousands of levs), and the tick mark is at 70000. Describing this as "70000 хиляди лева" (70,000 thousands of levs) is awkward. A clearer phrasing would be "стойност, която превишава 70000" (a value that exceeds 70,000), with the unit context already established by the axis description.
